MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What do we call the sound at the beginning of a Mandarin syllable, such as h in hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. An initial
   B. A stroke
   C. A tone
   D. A final

2. Which greeting is the polite way to say hello to a teacher? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫 wǒ jiào
   B. 谢谢 xièxie
   C. 您好 nín hǎo
   D. 再见 zàijiàn

3. What does 那 (nà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. Younger brother
   C. Older brother
   D. That

4. What is special about Mandarin words for brothers and sisters? (1 mark)
   A. There are different words for older and younger ones
   B. They are only used by adults
   C. They have no tones
   D. They are all the same word

5. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子____。 (The television is on the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 下
   C. 上
   D. 在

6. Which word means "under" in 椅子在桌子下? (1 mark)
   A. 桌
   B. 上
   C. 在
   D. 下

7. Which is an activity at a birthday party? (1 mark)
   A. 洗手 washing hands
   B. 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   C. 刮风 the wind blows
   D. 上学 going to school

8. Which Chinese word means "banana"? (1 mark)
   A. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   B. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   C. 早饭 zǎofàn
   D. 菠菜 bōcài

9. Which Chinese word means "meat"? (1 mark)
   A. 水 shuǐ
   B. 饼 bǐng
   C. 吃 chī
   D. 肉 ròu

10. Which Chinese word means "dinner"? (1 mark)
   A. 牛肉 niúròu
   B. 午饭 wǔfàn
   C. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   D. 喜欢 xǐhuan

11. What is a good safety tip in strong rain? (1 mark)
   A. Shelter under a tall tree in a storm
   B. Stay away from fast rivers
   C. Ignore warnings
   D. Play near the river

12. Which sentence means "Where is the sofa?"? (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱在厨房。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 沙发在哪儿?
   D. 门在左边。

13. What does 再见 zàijiàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning
   B. Goodbye
   C. Hello
   D. Thank you

14. What does 老师 (lǎoshī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. You
   B. To be called
   C. And you? (a question word)
   D. Teacher

15. In the syllable mā, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. ma
   B. a
   C. m
   D. ā only with a dot

16. Which sentence means "This is my older sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妹妹。
   B. 那是我弟弟。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 这是我姐姐。

17. What should you say when giving feedback on someone's reading? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only what was bad
   C. One good thing and one thing to improve
   D. Something unkind

18. How many rooms are named in 我家有客厅、卧室和厨房? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Three
   C. Two
   D. Four

19. Which word is pronounced jiàotáng? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺
   B. 明天
   C. 去
   D. 教堂

20. What does 教堂 (jiàotáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. Yesterday
   C. Mosque
   D. Church

21. Which sentence is in the right order for "We cut the cake"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 切我们蛋糕。
   C. 蛋糕我们切。
   D. 蛋糕切我们。

22. What does 十二月十二号 mean? (1 mark)
   A. 2 October
   B. 12 January
   C. 10 December
   D. 12 December

23. What does 午饭 (wǔfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Grapes
   B. Lunch
   C. Beef
   D. To eat

24. Read the pinyin: zhè shì shénme? What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is this?
   B. I drink tea.
   C. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   D. I like to eat bananas.

25. Which sentence means "For breakfast I eat bǐng."? (1 mark)
   A. 我早饭吃饼。
   B. 这是香蕉。
   C. 我喝茶。
   D. 我喜欢吃香蕉。

26. Fill the blank: 我用眼睛____。 (I use my eyes to see.) (1 mark)
   A. 听
   B. 喝
   C. 看
   D. 说

27. What does decoding a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Copying it
   B. Hiding it
   C. Drawing it
   D. Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it

28. What does 有 (yǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Father
   B. Is, am, are
   C. To have, there is
   D. Older sister

29. Which word is pronounced gēge? (1 mark)
   A. 谁
   B. 哥哥
   C. 家
   D. 爱

30. Which sentence means "The chair is under the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 椅子在桌子下。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 卧室里有床。

31. Read the pinyin: kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is on the table.
   B. There is a television in the living room.
   C. The window is above the sofa.
   D. The door is on the left.

32. What does 八 (bā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Eight
   C. Nine
   D. Ten

33. What does 去 (qù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. To go
   C. Mosque
   D. Church

34. What does 星期一 (xīngqīyī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Monday
   C. Five
   D. Today

35. What does 饼 (bǐng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flat bread
   B. Vegetables
   C. Chicken (meat)
   D. Coffee

36. What does 零食 (língshí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Breakfast
   C. Snacks
   D. To like

37. What does 眼睛 (yǎnjing) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tooth
   B. Eye
   C. Shoulder
   D. Ear

38. Which sentence means "The rain is heavy."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 这是太阳。
   D. 风很小。

39. What memory trick helps with 右? (1 mark)
   A. It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   B. It has 工 in it
   C. It has 女 in it
   D. It has 日 in it

40. What does 大家好 dàjiā hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Hello, everybody
   C. Goodbye
   D. Happy birthday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points. (5 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 放 and 蜡烛. (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 说 and 再见. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house." (3 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 八 and 玩. (2 marks)

46. Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning. (2 marks)

47. Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials. (3 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Where is the sofa?" (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." (2 marks)

50. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng. (2 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Friday, go to the mosque." (3 marks)

52. Name two fruits, one vegetable and one drink in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

53. Write the stroke order of 大 in Chinese stroke names. (2 marks)

54. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie! (2 marks)

55. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 饮料, 两 and 刀. (3 marks)

56. Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why. (2 marks)

57. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水果 and 蔬菜. (2 marks)

58. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水, 没有 and 门. (3 marks)

59. Explain what the part 女 tells us in 妈, 姐 and 妹. (3 marks)

60. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing. (2 marks)

61. Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it. (4 marks)

62. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 看. (2 marks)

63. What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it. (2 marks)

64. Give two habits of an active listener. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — An initial
   The consonant sound at the start of a syllable is the initial.

2. C — 您好 nín hǎo
   您 is the polite form of you.

3. D — That
   那 (nà) means that.

4. A — There are different words for older and younger ones
   Mandarin has gēge and dìdi, jiějie and mèimei.

5. C — 上
   上 means on.

6. D — 下
   下 xià means under or below.

7. B — 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   切蛋糕 is cut the cake.

8. B — 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

9. D — 肉 ròu
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

10. C — 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

11. B — Stay away from fast rivers
   Floods are dangerous and fast rivers are unsafe.

12. C — 沙发在哪儿?
   沙发在哪儿? (shāfā zài nǎr?) means "Where is the sofa?".

13. B — Goodbye
   再见 means see you again, goodbye.

14. D — Teacher
   老师 (lǎoshī) means teacher.

15. B — a
   m is the initial and a is the final, with the first tone.

16. D — 这是我姐姐。
   姐姐 is older sister.

17. C — One good thing and one thing to improve
   Kind feedback names a strength and one suggestion.

18. B — Three
   The rooms are the living room, the bedroom and the kitchen.

19. D — 教堂
   教堂 is pronounced jiàotáng and means church.

20. D — Church
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

21. A — 我们切蛋糕。
   The order is who, action, thing.

22. D — 12 December
   十二月 is December.

23. B — Lunch
   午饭 (wǔfàn) means lunch.

24. A — What is this?
   zhè shì shénme? is 这是什么?, which means "What is this?".

25. A — 我早饭吃饼。
   我早饭吃饼。 (wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.) means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

26. C — 看
   看 is to see.

27. D — Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   Decoding uses letter-sound knowledge.

28. C — To have, there is
   有 (yǒu) means to have, there is.

29. B — 哥哥
   哥哥 is pronounced gēge and means older brother.

30. B — 椅子在桌子下。
   椅子在桌子下。 (yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.) means "The chair is under the table.".

31. B — There is a television in the living room.
   kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. is 客厅里有电视。, which means "There is a television in the living room.".

32. B — Eight
   八 (bā) means eight.

33. B — To go
   去 (qù) means to go.

34. B — Monday
   星期一 (xīngqīyī) means Monday.

35. A — Flat bread
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

36. C — Snacks
   零食 (língshí) means snacks.

37. B — Eye
   眼睛 (yǎnjing) means eye.

38. A — 雨很大。
   雨很大。 (yǔ hěn dà.) means "The rain is heavy.".

39. A — It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   Most people eat with the right hand.

40. B — Hello, everybody
   大家 is everybody.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 放: fàng, to put. 蜡烛: làzhú, candle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 说: shuō, to speak. 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 八: bā, eight. 玩: wán, to play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: zhuōzi, table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose pebbles, sand, maize grains, sticks or plasticine. Lay out each stroke in the correct order: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩. Check the order with a partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the material, 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for checking.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在哪儿? shāfā zài nǎr?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五,去清真寺。 xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 菠菜 bōcài, 茶 chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruits, 1 mark for vegetable, 1 mark for drink.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 横, 撇, 捺.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all three in order, 1 mark for two.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: 饮料: yǐnliào, drinks. 两: liǎng, two (before a counting word). 刀: dāo, knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the changed sound and 1 mark for the rule.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: 水果: shuǐguǒ, fruit (as a group). 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 水: shuǐ, water. 没有: méiyǒu, there is not. 门: mén, door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: 女 means woman or female, so the characters are for female family members.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the link to family, 1 mark for naming the three characters.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

61. (4 marks)
   Answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 看: kàn, to look, to see.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.
